name: tag
title: Tag
description: A compact tag component for labeling and categorization with icon, image, avatar, and dismiss support. Uses namespace exports: Tag.Root, Tag.Icon, Tag.DismissButton.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Tag from ...`, use `<Tag.Root>` instead of `<Tag>`. Sub-components renamed: `TagIcon` → `Tag.Icon`, `TagClose` → `Tag.DismissButton`. Dependencies changed from `cva` + `react-icons` to `tv` + `@remixicon/react`. Old `tag-utils.ts` file is no longer included.

docs.lead: A compact tag component for labeling and categorization with icon, image, avatar, and dismiss support.
docs.usage:
import * as Tag from "@/components/ui/tag"

<Tag.Root>
  <Tag.Icon as={RiPushpinFill} />
  Customer
</Tag.Root>
